information:
![West Coast Cubing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc29SIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e561d0a9c0d6249576e169bfde3e7dbcbf20fe23/wcc-banner.png)

- This competition is in partnership with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC)

- This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. 

- This competition will take place at different venues across California and Reno. If you are potentially unable to reach these locales, we would highly recommend refraining from registering from this competition.

-  Check out the Location Tab for more details.
